rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: MCP Security Audit is a security scanning tool that analyzes MCP server definitions, AI agent skills, and plugins for over 68 known attack signatures including credential theft patterns, seed phrase harvesting, and code execution injection.
